item.title: Modder builds a CPU cooler powered by "infinite" ice from a hacked ice maker
item.description: The experiment sits halfway between absurdist entertainment and an intriguing case study in thermal engineering. The concept is deceptively simple: use melting ice to absorb the CPU's heat, then recycle the meltwater to make new ice, forming a closed-loop cooling system.Read Entire Article

item.title: Broadcom bets on 2nm stacked silicon to rival Nvidia in AI
item.description: The technology is based on a vertically integrated design that bonds two chips into a single stack.
